rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tiny initial drop is semen from the man's loins and the woman's breastbones, deliberately apportioned by God and emitted through desire as a trial of human origins.
rows.anchor: أي ماء من صلب الرجل وترائب المرأة مقصود ومقدر من الله لابتلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passive construction reflects that semen is emitted into the womb without the person's choice, as if he had no agency in it.
rows.anchor: حتى أن وقت صبها في الرحم انصبت منه بغير اختياره حتى كأنه لا فعل له فيها أصلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle of distance marks the astonishing greatness of the transformation and also temporal delay.
rows.anchor: أشار إليه بأداة البعد مع إفادتها للتراخي في الزمان أيضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A ʿalaqa is fresh, bright-red, intensely red and thick blood.
rows.anchor: أي دما أحمر عبيطا شديد الحمرة والغلظة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God then determines and forms the person's flesh, bones, nerves, and other substances and attributes.
rows.anchor: قدر سبحانه عقب ذلك لحمه وعظامه وعصبه وغير ذلك من جواهره وأعراضه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He proportioned the result into another creation, a fully adjusted, independent person.
rows.anchor: أي عدل عن ذلك خلقا آخر غاية التعديل شخصا مستقلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two sexes are paired but differ in temperament, bodily organs, faculties, and enjoyments.
rows.anchor: وهما كما تعلمون متباينان في الطباع مختلفان في أوصاف الأعضاء والآلات والمتاع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Distinguishing male from female out of one drop is subtler than separating a dead person's dust from earth, proving God's power to reassemble the dead.
rows.anchor: تمييز ما يصلح منه للذكر وما يصلح منه للأنثى أشد وأخفى من تمييز تراب الميت من تراب الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not abandon the drop, clot, morsel, or bones, but carries each stage through to a complete new creation in accord with manifest wisdom.
rows.anchor: كما لم يترك النطفة حتى صيرها علقة ولا ترك العلقة حتى صيرها مضغة ولا ترك المضغة حتى صيرها عظاما

words: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْىِۦَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The perfected first creation refutes hesitation about resurrection: the supreme Creator can revive the dead however He wills, all at once or successively.
rows.anchor: أي الخالق المسوي الإله الأعظم الذي قدر على هذه الإنشاءات وصنع هذه الصنائع المتقنة

words: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْىِۦَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sūra's conclusion returns to its opening by joining the collection of bones with resurrection for the Day of Gathering.
rows.anchor: وقد رجع آخر السورة على أولها أتم رجوع

words: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْىِۦَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet's instruction: after reciting the cited endings of al-Tin, al-Qiyama, or al-Mursalat, respond respectively as a witness, with yes, or with belief in God.
rows.anchor: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال : رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْىِۦَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
rows.speaker: الترمذي
rows.claim: Al-Tirmidhi transmits the response at the end of al-Qiyama as yes, by the might of our Lord.
rows.anchor: ورواه الترمذي وقال في آخر القيامة أن يحيي الموتى . ( بلى وعزة ربنا )

words: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْىِۦَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
rows.speaker: الحافظ نور الدين الهيثمي
rows.claim: Al-Haythami says Ahmad also narrated the recitation-response report, but its chain contains two men he did not know.
rows.anchor: وقال الحافظ نور الدين الهيثمي في مجمع الزوائد : وروى أحمد وفيه رجلان لم أعرفهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sūra is also called Hal Ata, al-Amshaj, and al-Dahr.
rows.anchor: وتسمى هل أتى والأمشاج والدهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its purpose is to warn humanity through the final judgment in al-Qiyama: all creation is assembled for punishment of disobedient people and reward of the obedient, amid terrifying stations; human origins and ends make this especially clear.
rows.anchor: مقصودها ترهيب الإنسلنت بما دل عليه آخر القيامة من العرض على الملك الديان بتعذيب العاصي في النيران وتنعيم المطيع في الجنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the basmala, God is King who created beings to know His beautiful names; the All-Merciful gives outwardly to all, while the Especially Merciful grants chosen beloved servants inward bounty and the highest station.
rows.anchor: الملك الذي خلق الخلائق لمعرفة أسمائه الحسنى { الرحمن } الذي عمهم بنعمة الظاهرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction is framed alongside the warning in al-Muddaththir, the weighty Qur'anic message in al-Muzzammil, and the reminder not to move one's tongue in al-Qiyama; the sūra of al-Jinn also treats the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: { لا تحرك به لسانك } ) 77 [ القيامة : 16 ] الملتفتة إلى ما في المدثر من أن هذه تذكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an chiefly establishes its own greatness as the central miraculous sign; once that sign is established, the rest of the law follows. A wise speaker repeats a resisted point indirectly until it settles in the hearer's mind.
rows.anchor: فإنه المقصود بالذات من أمر الآية الكبرى التي إذا ثبتت تبعها جميع المراد من الشريعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is to endure God's decree concerning those whom He has judged astray, and whatever befalls him, obeying God's commands; he should recall that a compassionate nurturer educates through hardship and ease according to wisdom.
rows.anchor: أي المحسن إليك بتخصيصه لك بهذه النعمة على ضلال من حكم بضلاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience is restraining and steadying the self against desire so it does not follow blameworthy pleasures.
rows.anchor: والصبر : حبس النفس وضبطها على مقاومة الهوى لئلا تنقاد إلى شيء من قبائح اللذات

words: وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opponents who solicit obedience are the unbelievers, opposed to the grateful; the prohibition names those inviting to sin or unbelief, leaving unmentioned cases outside this particular ban.
rows.anchor: وكان المخالفون له صلى الله عليه وسلم هم القسم المضاد للشاكر وهم الكفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An athim is someone who invites the Prophet to sin, whether or not that sin is joined to unbelief.
rows.anchor: أي داعيا إلى إثم سواء كان مجردا عن مطلق الكفر أو مصاحبا له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A kafur is an emphatic unbeliever who calls others to unbelief; worldly power and greatness do not outweigh the truth.
rows.anchor: أي مبالغا في الكفر وداعيا إليه وإن كان كبيرا وعظيما في الدنيا فإن الحق أكبر من كل كبير

words: وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Despite severely harming the Prophet, the opponents offered him wealth, control, and marriage to their most eminent women if he would adopt their religion and stop his preaching.
rows.anchor: كانوا مع شدة الأذى له صلى الله عليه وسلم يبذلون له الرغائب من الأموال , والتمليك والتزويج لأعظم نسائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The indefinite either-or prohibition forbids each of the two categories individually, since they stand at the same rank of avoidance.
rows.anchor: والنهي عن الأحد المبهم نهي عن كل منهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A portion of the night is for worship, with the rest left for sleep and rest.
rows.anchor: أي بعضه والباقي للراحة بالنوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here prostrating means praying Maghrib and Isha; mentioning prostration highlights the prayer's most excellent act and marks night as a time of submission.
rows.anchor: أي فصل له صلاتي المغرب والعشاء , وذكرهما بالسجود تنبيها على أنه أفضل الصلاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Placing the time phrase first emphasizes night prayer's extra difficulty, sincerity, and merit: fewer sensory distractions make it less exposed to showing off and deepen humility and delight in worship.
rows.anchor: وتقديم الظرف لما في صلاة الليل من مزيد الكلفة والخلوص ومزيد الفضيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying God for a long night means tahajjud; the duration may be half the night, more, or less.
rows.anchor: أي بالتهجد { ليلا طويلا * } نصفه أو أكثر منه أو أقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is called glorification because struggling to rise and overcoming sleep recall God's majesty and transcendence; abandoning beloved rest signals profound love for God.
rows.anchor: ولعله سماه تسبيحا لأن مكابدة القيام فيه وغلبة النوم تذكر بما لله من العظمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke of those who love immediate life explains the preceding command not to obey sinful or unbelieving opponents.
rows.anchor: ولما أنهى أمره بلازم النهي , علل النهي بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those heedless of God, including unbelievers and others, deserve God's displeasure because they love the present life and its desires, while rejecting the later life.
rows.anchor: أي الذين يغفلون عن الله من الكفرة وغيرهم فاستحقوا المقت من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿājila is the transient present world, attractive because of its pleasures and limited to a short span.
rows.anchor: أي ويأخذون منها ويستخفون لما حفت به من الشهوات زمنا قليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They leave the coming day unprepared for, in a state that will distress them when they see it.
rows.anchor: أي يتركون منها على حالة هي من أقبح ما يسوءهم إذا رأوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Warāʾahum can mean ahead of them, encompassing them while they turn away, or behind them because the day comes after them and inevitably catches them.
rows.anchor: أي أمامهم أي قدامهم على وجه الإحاطة بهم وهم عنه معرضون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The day is exceedingly heavy with calamities they cannot bear because they made no preparation for it.
rows.anchor: أي شديدا جدا لا يطيقون حمل ما فيه من المصائب بسبب أنهم لا يعدون له عدته

words: يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse uses the rhetorical pattern of ḥtibāk: mentioning love and the present first implies their opposites later, while leaving and heaviness later imply the opposites in the first half, exposing lack of foresight.
rows.anchor: فالآية من الاحتباك : ذكر الحب والعاجلة أولا دلالة على ضدهما ثانيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sūra is also called al-ʿUrf; its name and the oath terminology point attentive readers toward its message.
rows.anchor: سورة المرسلات وتسمى العرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sūra establishes humanity's final outcome: grateful people receive bliss and disbelievers fiery punishment after bodies are gathered and life is restored through God's power over creation, provision, knowledge, human development, faith, and disbelief; the Qur'an's inimitability confronts humans and jinn.
rows.anchor: مقصودها الدلالة على آخر الإنسان من إثابة الشاكرين بالنعيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala names God as fully powerful, universally generous to all servants, and especially generous to those He favors, completing their blessing and granting more.
rows.anchor: الذي له القدرة التامة على ما يريد { الرحمن } الذي له عموم الإنعام على سائر العبيد { الرحيم } الذي خص أهل رضوانه بإتمام ذلك الإنعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lowly water is a contemptible, weak, filthy drop.
rows.anchor: أي نطفة مذرة ذليلة , وهو من مهن بالفتح

rows.speaker: القاموس
rows.claim: Al-Qamus defines mahīn as contemptible, weak, or scant.
rows.anchor: قال في القاموس : والمهين : الحقير الضعيف والقليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God places the drop in the womb, a secure receptacle protected from air and other harms, for development through successive stages.
rows.anchor: أي محفوظ مما يفسده من الهواء وغيره ومددنا ذلك لأجل التطوير في أطوار الخلقة والتدوير في أدوار الصنعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The measured term is the divinely appointed time until birth, from nine months to more or less, known to God alone.
rows.anchor: من تسعة أشهر للولادة إلى ما فوقها أو دونها لا يعلمه غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faqaddarnā can mean that God determined the process by His greatness, or set provisions, lifespans, and deeds to known measures.
rows.anchor: أي بعظمتنا على ذلك أو فجعلناه على مقدار معلوم من الأرزاق والآجال والأعمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The praise means God is fully able, or that He assigns those measures with complete majesty; the plural may allude to the angels and other causes God established.
rows.anchor: نحن مطلقا على ذلك وغيره , أو المقدرون في تلك المقادير لما لنا من كمال العظمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The created causes, including angels, make this process a trial for both monotheists and polytheists.
rows.anchor: ولعل التعبير بما قد يفيد مع العظمة الجمع لما أقام سبحانه في ذلك من الأسباب بالملائكة وغيرها , وفيه مع ذلك ابتلاء للعباد الموحد منهم والمشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deniers knowingly reject resurrection despite witnessing God's power to create and measure them, and refuse to reason from the analogous beginning.
rows.anchor: وهم يعلمون قدرتنا على ما ذكر وتقديره من ابتدائنا لخلقهم وغيره مما يفيد كمال القدرة وهم يكذبون بالبعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After citing destruction as evidence of power over resurrection, the author points to initial creation as an even clearer proof.
rows.anchor: ولما ذكر الإهلاك على ذلك الوجه الدال على القدرة التامة على البعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kifāt can mean a vessel that gathers and encloses what is put into it; the author also offers a noun for enclosing, a verbal noun used adjectivally, a plural form, or a plural of kifat meaning container.
rows.anchor: أي وعاء قابلة لجمع ما يوضع فيه وضمه جميعا فيه فتك وهدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The form may be a verbal noun used as an adjective, like ṣāʾima/ṣiyām, or a plural of kāfita or kifat.
rows.anchor: أو هو مصدرنعت به أوجمع كافتة , كصائمة وصيام أو جمع كفت وهو الوعاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earth gathers and holds people; God could make it spread them like plants when they are placed in it, as He will at resurrection.
rows.anchor: ولو شئنا لجعلناها ناشرة لكم إذا وضعتم فيها كما تنشر النبات , وسنجعل ذلك إذا أردنا البعث

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet says the community will be raised in ten forms: apes, pigs, dragged face-down, blind, deaf-mute, tongue-chewing, mutilated, nailed to burning trunks, more foul than carrion, or tar-clad.
rows.anchor: فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( إن أمتي تحشر على عشرة أصناف : على صور القردة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The report maps these forms to talebearers, illicit and usurious eaters, unjust judges, the self-admiring, scholars whose actions contradict their words, abusive neighbors, informants to rulers, those who follow desires and withhold God's due, and the arrogant.
rows.anchor: فسرهم بالقتات وآكلي السحت وأكلة الربا والجائرين في الحكم والمعجبين بأعمالهم والعلماء الذي يخالف قولهم فعلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Biqai calls the story that Muʿadh asked about the crowds and the Prophet gave this answer manifestly fabricated.
rows.anchor: إنه ظاهر الوضع أن معاذا رضي الله عنه سأل عن هذه الأفواج فقال النبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky is split in great cracks that make it appear to consist entirely of many doors.
rows.anchor: أي شقق هذا الجنس تشقيقا كبيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passive construction focuses on the opening itself and underscores how easily the powerful agent can alter things.
rows.anchor: بانيا للمفعول لأن المفزع مطلق التفتيح , ولأن ذلك أدل على قدرة الفاعل وهوان الأمور عليه

rows.speaker: الكوفيون
rows.claim: The Kufans read the verb with a light fāʾtaḥat; the resulting doors already convey the sense of repeated opening.
rows.anchor: وقرأ الكوفيون بالتخفيف لأن التكثير يدل عليه ما سبب عن الفتح من قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mountains are moved effortlessly through the air like scattered dust, then disappear into mirage as their particles disperse.
rows.anchor: على ما تعلمون من صلابتها وصعبوتها في الهواء كأنها الهباء المنثور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell is a lookout where its wardens watch for God's enemies and seize them when they arrive.
rows.anchor: أي موضع رصد لأعداء الله ترصدهم فيها خزنة النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, its wardens watch for God's friends so Paradise's wardens can rescue them from the Fire when they reach it.
rows.anchor: ولأولياء الله ترصدهم فيها خزنة الجنة لإنجائهم من النار عند ورودها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Hell itself is an intensely watchful sentry, personified as an inescapable collector of all unbelievers, like an intensive noun for one who stabs repeatedly.
rows.anchor: أوهي راصدة بليغة الرصد للكفار حتى صارت مجسدة من الرصد لتجمع أصحابها فلا يفوت منهم واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author describes seven checkpoints: confession, prayer, alms, fasting, pilgrimage, minor pilgrimage, and wrongs; if wrongs remain, optional worship completes one's deeds before the person proceeds to Paradise.
rows.anchor: مجالس يسأل عند أولها عن شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله , فإن جاء بها تامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because averting harm takes priority over gaining benefit, the fearful destination is presented first.
rows.anchor: ولما كان درء المفاسد أولى من جلب المصالح , قدم ذكر المخوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ṭāghīn are those who exceed God's bounds.
rows.anchor: أي المجاوزين لحدود الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Maʾāb means a return and abode: people were created for it, then prepared to depart through their primordial nature, revealed books, and messengers, before their denial brings them back.
rows.anchor: أي مرجعا ومأوى بعد أن كان الله ذرأهم لها فكأنهم كانوا فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question is addressed to the noblest of creation to prompt reflection and consideration, console the Prophet, and warn those who reject him.
rows.anchor: مخاطبا لأشرف الخلق إشارة إلى أنه لا يعتبر هذا حق اعتباره إلا أنت , مستفهما عن التيان للتنبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' story recalls how even Pharaoh, the earth's most powerful ruler with vast armies and sorcery, persisted despite extraordinary signs, so God drowned him and his people completely.
rows.anchor: وقد كان أقوى أهل الأرض , بما كان له من الملك وكثرة الجنود وقوتهم وسحرهم ومرودهم في خداعهم ومكرهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An unnamed view says Pharaoh's vanguard numbered six hundred thousand, matching the number of the Children of Israel.
rows.anchor: بحيث إنه قيل : إن طليعته كانت على عدد بني إسرائيل ستمائة ألف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The holy valley is purified and honored by God's conferral of prophethood, which spreads blessings.
rows.anchor: أي المطهر غاية التطهر بتشريف الله له بإنزال النبوة المفيضة للبركات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author explains Ṭuwā as the place where evil was folded away from Israel and prophetic blessings spread across the earth through Islam and the lifting of collective destruction.
rows.anchor: وهو الذي طوى فيه الشر عن بني إسرائيل ومن أراد الله من خلقه ونشر بركات النبوة على جميع أهل الأرض

rows.speaker: العلماء
rows.claim: The scholars say the punishment of the grave, glossed here as total destruction, was lifted when the Torah was revealed.
rows.anchor: فإن العلماء قالوا : إن عذاب القبر أي عذاب الاستئصال ارتفع حين أنزلت التوراة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The valley is located at Mount Sinai, between Aylah and Egypt.
rows.anchor: وهو واد بالطور بين أيلة ومصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God ordered Moses to confront Egypt's king, who enslaved Israel and feared an Israelite child; God raised Moses in Pharaoh's house as the instrument of Pharaoh's ruin, and Moses later fled after killing a man.
rows.anchor: ملك مصر الذي كان استعبد بني إسرائيل ثم خوف من واحد منهم فصار يذبح أبناءهم خوفا منه وهو أنت فربيناك في بتيه لهلاكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's transgression made him liable to stern recompense; the command reassures Moses that Pharaoh has no power over him.
rows.anchor: أي الحد وتجاوز الحد فاستحق المقابلة بالجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hal laka asks whether Pharaoh has a desire or need for the proposed purification.
rows.anchor: أي ميل وحاجة { إلى أن تزكى * } أي تتحلى بالفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purification means acquiring virtues and cleansing outwardly and inwardly from vices, beginning even with the lowest degree: accepting faith and freeing Israel.
rows.anchor: أي تتحلى بالفضائل , وتتطهر من الرذائل , ولو بأدنى أنواع التزكي : الطهارة الظاهرة والباطنة الموجبة للنماء والكثرة

rows.speaker: الحجازيان ويعقوب
rows.claim: The Hijazis and Yaqub read with a doubled zāy, indicating more complete purification; a person guided by a perfect messenger may reach its fullest degree.
rows.anchor: وقرأ الحجازيان ويعقوب بالتشديد أي تزكية بليغة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Omitting one tāʾ from the form of tafaʿʿul lightens the expression and suggests the lower, easier degree of purification.
rows.anchor: وإفهام الأدنى بما يشير إليه إسقاط تاء التفعل المقتضي للتخفيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After purification from associating partners with God, Moses offers to guide Pharaoh to his Lord, the creator, benefactor, and nurturer who teaches pleasing actions and blameworthy traits; this develops the gentle call in Ta Ha.
rows.anchor: أي أبين لك بعد التزكية بالإيمان الذي هو الأساس : كيف المسير { إلى ربك } أي الموجد لك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance should lead Pharaoh to act in fear: perform obligations and avoid prohibitions, completing purification. Fear motivates all good, while feeling secure encourages evil.
rows.anchor: أي فيتسبب عن ذلك أنك تصير تعمل أعمال من يخاف من عذابه خوفا عظيما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preceding reference to those who do not hear Hell's faintest sound is linked to the statement in al-Anbiyaʾ 21:102.
rows.anchor: الأنبياء : 102 ] . ولما كان جواب ( إذا ) كما مضى محذوفا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer to the conditional when-clause is omitted; the author supplies the sense that people are divided into two groups, one destined for Hell and one for bliss.
rows.anchor: وكان تقديره أن قسم الناس قسمين : قسم للجحيم وقسم للنعيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The transgressor exceeds the bounds of aggression and does not fear standing before his Lord.
rows.anchor: أي تجاوز الحد في العدوان فلم يخش مقام ربه

rows.speaker: القاموس
rows.claim: Al-Qamus says ṭaghā means exceeding the measure or rising; it can also mean disbelief, excess in sins and oppression, and is used of rising water.
rows.anchor: قال في القاموس : طغى : جاوز القدر وارتفع وطغى : إلا في الكفر وأسرف في المعاصي والظلم , والماء : ارتفع
